info.sub_ename: CULTURE AND THE POETRY IN THE TANG DYNASTY

description.sub_ename: CULTURE AND THE POETRY IN THE TANG DYNASTY
description.describe_ch: 詩歌常被視為文學的起源，它利用高度凝鍊的語言，按照一定的格律要求，表達作者心靈感受，同時反映社會生活。本課程希望讓學生透過觀察《全唐詩》，瞭解唐代文化特色及詩人生活特性，文學作品是社會的一面鏡子，我們能橫向觀察從《全唐詩》中看到唐代社會和生活百態；文學作品更是時代的縮影，我們也能夠縱向觀察從《全唐詩》瞭解時代精神和變遷軌跡。
description.describe_eh: Poetry is often regarded as the origin of literature. It uses highly condensed language to express the author's spiritual feelings and reflect social life in accordance with certain metrical requirements. This course aims to equip students with understandings of the cultural characteristics of the Tang Dynasty and the life traits of poets through "The Complete Tang Poems". Literary works are a mirror of society. From "The Complete Tang Poems", we can observe the society and life in the Tang Dynasty. Literary works are also the epitome of time. We can also dive in the spirit of the times and the track of historical changes from "The Complete Tang Poems".
